Title: Global Stock Market News and World Indices Coverage
# World Markets. Sterling falls as UK unemployment hits highest rate in five years. Gold rises over 2% as soft inflation data rekindles Fed rate-cut hopes. Dollar flat after inflation data, yen set for strong weekly gain. Oil prices stable as investors weigh OPEC+ supply, US inflation data. Asia stock markets track losses on Wall Street as AI fears hit sentiment. European markets close mixed as investors digest big batch of earnings. Asia markets mostly rise as investors shrug off weak U.S. retail sales, assess China inflation. Gold drops as investors brace for US jobs and inflation numbers. ## Trending Now. ## More In World Markets. Japan's Nikkei 225 crosses 57,000 for the first time as Takaichi secures historic mandate. Gold bounces back on softer dollar, U.S.-Iran concerns; silver rebounds. Dollar retreats from two-week high, yen set for weekly loss. Oil settles almost 3% down on easing supply concerns ahead of U.S., Iran talks. South Korea's Kospi leads declines in Asia, tracking Wall Street tech sell-off; Topix retreats from record. Asia stocks trade mostly higher, breaking ranks with Wall Street. European markets close lower on 'super Thursday' earnings day. Gold jumps over 3% to fresh highs as Asia stock markets mostly rise. European chip stocks end lower after ASML earnings; LVMH falls. South Korea's Kospi hits record high for second straight session. European stocks rise after EU's 'mother of all deals' with India. Gold scales record peak as uncertainty fuels safe-haven bids. #### News Tips. Got a confidential news tip? We want to hear from you. #### CNBC Newsletters.
